units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:25">Gen. XXV, 25</cite>) <he>כולו ראוי לא׳</he> every one (of the Roman people) fit for the purple cloak (may become an emperor).

senses.gloss: (homiletically, as if אִדֶּרֶת = ch. אִדְּרָא, אִדַּר) the threshing floor, the store of grains. Ib. כולו מפוזר ומפורד כא׳ entirely destined to be scattered (winnowed) like the grains, לזרותו וכ׳ [שעתיד] for the Lord will scatter him (Edom-Rome) like chaff &c. (ref. to Dan. II, 35).
